avis.texte: I am 26 years old and still experience acne if I don't pay special attention to my skin every morning and evening. I have tried nearly everything, from prescription benzoyl peroxide to other chemicals and organic/natural treatments. This stuff is the best I've found, not just in its price range, but out of everything. It is head and shoulders above much more expensive options. A couple notes: - You can use this as a spot treatment or all over your face (I use it all over). - You can use this anywhere from once every other day to twice a day (I use it twice a day when breaking out and every other day when my skin is clear). - This WILL cause dryness if you use it regularly all over your face. Make sure you have a reliable moisturizer (a deep-penetrating night moisturizer and one with an SPF for daytime is best). - For best results (but also more dryness), you can pair with a toner or astringent.

I’ve never had a product work as quickly and effectively as this one. I can’t believe it’s as inexpensive as it is while delivering such solid results. I used to pass right over it because I erroneously equated effectiveness with price, but I bought a tube based on someone’s recommendation. I’ve used it ever since.
It’s a shame that even though I am an adult I managed to still get acne, but, this stuff works absolutely fantastic
